text: Add a convention for readings and plans: a criterion with a numeric performance target (such as wall time under N minutes) must cite a measured baseline from the base commit. It must also include a per-component estimate showing the target can be reached within the allowed change scope. If no such estimate exists, the reading must say the target is unproven and flag it for the user before work starts, so the job is not dispatched against it unseen. Add a test that a reading with an unbacked numeric target is flagged.
